en: Badi al-Zaman Isma'il ibn al-Razzaz al-Jazari
ar: بديع الزمان إسماعيل بن الرزاز الجزري

description.tr: Robotik ve makine mühendisliğinin babası; ilk programlanabilir otomatı ve krank mili mekanizmasını tasarladı || Diyarbakır Artuklu hanedanına 25 yıl hizmet etti; 50 cihazı titizlikle resmedilmiştir || [Tarih notu] Kale saati ilk programlanabilir analog bilgisayar kabul edilir
description.en: Father of robotics and mechanical engineering; designed the first programmable automaton and crankshaft mechanism || Served the Artuqid dynasty of Diyarbakir for 25 years; his 50 devices are meticulously illustrated || [Historiographical note] His "castle clock" is considered the first programmable analog computer
description.ar: أبو الروبوتات والهندسة الميكانيكية || خدم سلالة الأرتقيين لمدة ٢٥ عاماً || [Historiographical note] تُعتبر ساعة القلعة أول حاسوب تناظري قابل للبرمجة
